purpose: Teach: 富豪/調教/落胆/軍部/反感/進入/出没/盗作

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、容疑者が富豪であることを把握されてますね
lines.en: So the police are aware the suspect is a wealthy individual in this case.
lines.style: Measured, analytical observation. Slight pause before speaking. Even tone. The cadence of someone thinking aloud, double-checking facts. No urgency—methodical.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犬の調教士の力もお借りしますね
lines.en: We're also bringing in a police dog handler for this investigation.
lines.style: Steady, professional briefing tone. Flat affect. State facts without elaboration. Businesslike pace. Brief, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者ご家族の落胆に配慮されてますね、警察
lines.en: The police are being thoughtful about the victim's family and their distress in this case.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Soft opening. Respectful pace, slower than usual. Undercurrent of empathy. Trailing slightly at the end as if acknowledging something unspoken.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、軍部関係者からの情報も丁寧に扱います
lines.en: We handle information from military contacts with appropriate care and discretion.
lines.style: Formal, official tone. Each word deliberate and weighted. No warmth. Professional distance maintained throughout. Steady, unvarying pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、市民の反感を招かないよう警察、配慮されてますね
lines.en: The police are taking measures to ensure this investigation doesn't stoke public resentment.
lines.style: Thoughtful, weighing consequences. Slow tempo. Slight emphasis on 'taking measures.' Voice carries awareness of broader stakes. Careful word choice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法進入者の防止に努めます
lines.en: We'll be working to prevent unauthorized access to the scene and evidence.
lines.style: Declarative and direct. Firm conviction on 'prevent.' No doubt in the delivery. Practical, no-nonsense tone. Consistent pace throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不審者が出没する地域を警察、巡回されてますね
lines.en: Patrols are being conducted in the areas where suspicious persons have been reported.
lines.style: Neutral, factual statement. Observational tone. Even pacing. Voice suggests routine procedure being carried out. No alarm, no reassurance—just information.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、盗作疑惑の捜査も担当します
lines.en: We're also investigating the plagiarism allegations as part of this case.
lines.style: Measured admission. Slight reserve. Direct eye contact implied in the voice. Not defensive, but acknowledging the additional complexity. Steady, unhurried delivery.
